method: Built-in image_gen; owner-supplied Atlas character pack as identity reference. Deterministic native-grid normalization and eye registration by scripts/build-traveler-sprites.mjs.

prompts.prompt: Preserve the cream hood and coat, navy face, cyan eyes, cobalt scarf and boots, golden embroidery and floating ringed blue planet. Centered full-body front-facing neutral mascot on alpha. Authentic 64px logical pixel grid, crisp square pixels, limited palette, no blur, text, scenery or ground shadow.

Same identity, 4x4 equal cells on alpha: four walking, four parchment reading, four magic casting, then idle, greet, sleep and victory. Same camera, body scale and feet baseline. Crisp pixel clusters, no labels or overlapping cells.

Eight progressive frames of one seamless walk cycle in a 4x2 transparent sheet: left contact/down/passing/up, right contact/down/passing/up, alternating legs, opposite arms, scarf follow-through. Same scale, camera and foot baseline; complete planet in every cell.

Two separately drawn compact and micro hood/face/planet icons for 32px and 16px use. Simplify full-body identity into a cream hood, navy interior, two cyan eyes and blue ringed planet; retain transparent padding and crisp pixel edges.

delivery: The source images are generation references, not runtime sheets. Shipping rasters use a fixed 24-color palette, binary alpha and registered 64/32/16px grids. The game reads one 20-cell native atlas.
